audit_scope: All payload files before archive_audit.json and archive_manifest.json were added; gzip JSONL is decompressed and every row is parsed and privacy-scanned; the final manifest is independently checked by scripts/run_archive_smoke.py. Public additions and edits are described in publication_overlay.
known_scope: Six-route and controls results are exploratory and do not establish quality noninferiority.
SWE-bench Verified Mini uses a fixed nonrandom 50-task cohort and one captured run per arm.
Hosted successful-response duration includes provider/network variation and is not full task wall time; B300 10-block plus 23/25-block timing uses one pinned task and excludes rewrite/setup time.
license_scope: No first-party public license is assigned; third-party terms are preserved in src/README.md.

publication_overlay.credential_scan: passed for binary/text content and PDF extracted text/metadata

source_transfer_policy: Every private-repository source was selected by an explicit file, config glob, or result-directory filename/subtree allowlist; only allowlisted README.md Markdown and no stale result-local integrity record were copied.
